title: USACE Fire Protection Engineer Speaks on Profession
description: Daniel Carson, a U.S. Army Corps of Engineers fire protection engineer, talks about his profession during 2024 Engineer Week on Camp Humphreys, South Korea, Feb. 21, 2024. Carson received his fire protection license in 2021 and was the first fire protection engineer in the district. (DoD video by Ha Na Pong)
keywords: United States Army Corps of Engineers, fire protection, human interest, Engineer Week, engineer appreciation
